sentences.en: i've been asked to say thank you but on behalf of all of the honorary degree recipients today it's a big task because i'm deeply humbled
sentences.zh: 我被要求说谢谢，但今天我代表所有荣誉学位获得者，这是一项艰巨的任务，因为我深感谦卑

sentences.en: to be in the company of the three other recipients of this award who had given so much to each of their fields of endeavor
sentences.zh: 与该奖项的其他三位获奖者在一起，他们为各自的努力领域做出了巨大贡献

sentences.en: and who have spent the life contributing i thank you for being a part of this day with me
sentences.zh: 以及那些一生做出贡献的人，我感谢你们与我一起度过这一天

sentences.en: because you value what i value which is the act of giving to others so thank you for being here with me
sentences.zh: 因为你看重我看重的东西，即给予他人的行为，所以感谢你和我在一起

sentences.en: now i have a thank you to mount sinai but before that i have a personal thank you and one of the wonderful things about being a
sentences.zh: 现在我要向西奈山表示感谢，但在此之前我要向您个人表示感谢，以及成为一名

sentences.en: justice they don't say no to you and so i'm taking the prerogative of having the podium
sentences.zh: 正义，他们不会对你说不，所以我有登上领奖台的特权

sentences.en: to say a public thank you to judah gribbets judah griffiths has been on the board of trustees of
sentences.zh: 向 Judah Gribbets 表示公开感谢 Judah Griffiths 一直是董事会成员

sentences.en: this institution since 1980 he's not a medical doctor he's a lawyer like i am
sentences.zh: 这个机构自 1980 年以来他不是医生他是像我一样的律师

sentences.en: and he sets an example of the finest service that lawyers give to our community
sentences.zh: 他为律师为我们的社区提供最好的服务树立了榜样

sentences.en: he is the man of the highest integrity i have never met someone with his degree of commitment
sentences.zh: 他是一个最正直的人，我从未见过像他这样忠诚的人

sentences.en: passion love and dedication to the profession and to the community he lives in
sentences.zh: 对他所生活的职业和社区的热爱和奉献

sentences.en: and i am especially grateful to him because yes it was senator moynihan who moves me into the current position i'm in
sentences.zh: 我特别感谢他，因为是的，正是莫伊尼汉参议员将我调到了现在的位置

sentences.en: but it all started when judah gribbetts was the chairperson of his selection committee and so i'm here
sentences.zh: 但这一切都始于犹大·格里贝茨担任他的遴选委员会主席，所以我在这里

sentences.en: because of him thank you judah well
sentences.zh: 因为他，谢谢你，犹大

sentences.en: i have many thank yous tonight thank you also to the class of 2015 for letting me share this special day with you
sentences.zh: 今晚我非常感谢你们，也感谢 2015 届的同学让我与你们分享这个特殊的日子

sentences.en: you should all take great pride in your graduation from this wonderful institution i applaud each of you for all you have accomplished
sentences.zh: 你们都应该为从这所出色的机构毕业而感到自豪，我为你们每个人所取得的成就而鼓掌

sentences.en: but i also applaud the family friends and professors who have helped you reach this moment in your lives
sentences.zh: 但我也向帮助你到达人生这一刻的家人朋友和教授表示赞赏

sentences.en: it is a true honor to receive a degree from an institution like mount sinai whose values are so close to mine
sentences.zh: 能够从像西奈山这样的机构获得学位是一种真正的荣幸，因为它的价值观与我如此接近

sentences.en: for more than 50 years mount sinai has been dedicated to providing exceptional care to the community it serves
sentences.zh: 50 多年来，西奈山一直致力于为其服务的社区提供卓越的护理

sentences.en: i know the quality of that care from my and my family's experiences as patients when my beloved cousin was dying of aids
sentences.zh: 当我心爱的表弟死于艾滋病时，我和我的家人作为病人的经历让我知道这种护理的质量

sentences.en: in the mid-1980s he came to mount sinai for treatment this was in the early days of the disease
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代中期，他来到西奈山接受治疗，当时正值疾病的早期阶段

sentences.en: when so much about it was still unknown mount sinai was one of the leaders in investigating aids and its staff and students used that
sentences.zh: 当很多事情仍然未知时，西奈山是调查艾滋病的领导者之一，其工作人员和学生使用了这一点

sentences.en: knowledge to do what they could for my cousin and for the many others who were just beginning to be afflicted with the then deadly disease
sentences.zh: 为我的表弟和其他许多刚刚开始遭受当时致命疾病折磨的人提供知识

sentences.en: i was deeply moved by the respect and dignity with which nelson's doctors and nurses treated him to this day
sentences.zh: 直到今天，纳尔逊的医生和护士对他的尊重和尊严让我深受感动

sentences.en: although i work and live in d.c i still have a doctor at this hospital thank you on my behalf and on the behalf of the other
sentences.zh: 虽然我在华盛顿工作和生活，但我在这家医院仍然有一名医生，代表我和其他人感谢您

sentences.en: honorary degree recipients for this tremendous honor graduates enjoy this day i wish you all success in your careers
sentences.zh: 荣誉学位获得者 这个伟大的荣誉毕业生 享受这一天 我祝你们 事业成功

sentences.en: as you practice remember that true success is found not in the position that you obtain but in whether
sentences.zh: 当你们练习时 记住真正的成功 并不在于你们所处的位置 而是在于你们是否

sentences.en: at the end of each day you can say you have treated your patients with compassion and to the best of your ability if you do that
sentences.zh: 在每一天的尽头,你可以说 你已经用同情心治疗你的病人 并且尽你最大的能力,如果你这样做

sentences.en: then i know that you will make mount sinai very proud of you congratulations class of 2015.
sentences.zh: 然后,我知道,你将使 山sinai 为你非常骄傲 恭喜班2015年。
